emi.title: Home Loan EMI Calculator
emi.subtitle: Work out the monthly outgo before you fall in love with a floor plan.
notes: Indicative only. Your sanctioned rate depends on the lender, your credit profile and the loan-to-value ratio.
Stamp duty, registration and GST are payable over and above the property price and are not financed by most lenders.
All our projects carry APF approval, so the loan process starts from documentation rather than from project appraisal.

roi.title: Return on Investment Calculator
roi.subtitle: Rental yield, capital appreciation and total return over your holding period.
notes: Appreciation rates are drawn from realised price movement in our delivered projects in the same micro-market. Past movement does not guarantee future movement.
Annual costs cover maintenance, property tax and insurance. Income tax on rent is not deducted here.
Occupancy below 100% accounts for vacancy between tenants, which is normal in commercial and industrial leasing.
